excluded_combinations.reason: A straight tuck's top lid hinges on the back panel's edge, where a hang tab stands; a hang tab takes a reverse, airplane or seal top.
A pillow box's faces are its front and back (front_window); its ends are curved closures.
The gable top is the handle; a window goes in the front panel.
A polygon carton closes with a polygon tuck lid (straight or reverse); seal and airplane ends are rectangular constructions.
The top is open (a display, a bag's mouth, a sleeve's or a holster's end); a window goes in the front.
